title: Labor Reimbursed on a Waiting-Period Re-decision Line — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
**Rule.** On a waiting-period re-decision line of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the labor reimbursed is set by how the store charged the covered labor. The covered labor is the store's customer-pay labor on the concern line of the repair order that carries its diagnostic fee, as recorded in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

**Terms used.**
- *Labor charged* is the amount charged on those labor lines.
- *List amount* is their hours times the store's labor rate before any discount.
- *Comeback credit* is any credit the store gave on that concern line as a comeback repair.
- *Standard labor amount* is the hours billed times the store's posted labor rate capped at the coverage level's labor-rate cap, rounded half up to the cent.

| How the covered labor was charged | Labor reimbursed |
|---|---|
| Below its list amount | the labor actually charged, never more than the standard labor amount (the lesser of the two) |
| At its list amount, carrying a comeback credit | the list amount less that credit, never more than the standard labor amount |
| Otherwise (at its list amount with no comeback credit) | the standard labor amount |

**Cases (hypothetical figures, hours 3.0, posted rate 158.00, cap 150.00, so the standard labor amount is 450.00).**
- Charged 426.60 against a list amount of 474.00: 426.60 is below 450.00, so 426.60 is reimbursed.
- Charged 470.00 against a list amount of 474.00: the lesser of 470.00 and 450.00 is 450.00.
- Charged at the list amount of 474.00 with a comeback credit of 94.80: 474.00 less 94.80 is 379.20, below 450.00, so 379.20 is reimbursed.
- Charged at the list amount of 474.00 with a comeback credit of 10.00: 464.00 is above 450.00, so 450.00 is reimbursed.
- Charged at the list amount of 474.00 with no comeback credit: 450.00.

**Boundary.** Labor charged exactly at its list amount is not "below" it, so the first row does not apply.
